attributes.additional_details:
Labour have been a disaster for this country ,.tensions are growing , the nation did not vote for anything that is happening , and now , Andy Burnham , a man who was not even an MP at the time this government came into power , is being allowed with no mandate , no public backing to take over the reigns .

We need and there must be a general election .
attributes.background:
Labour has failed us as a country . Starmer went against everything he promised . 

Now upon his resignation , a man who was not even an MP when this government has come into power with no mandate or public backing . 

We need a general election , and allow the public to decide .
